title: fragaria rupestris
intro: Fragaria rupestris, commonly known as the alpine strawberry or rocky strawberry, is a species of strawberry native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its high antioxidant content. The therapeutic actions of Fragaria rupestris are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ellagic acid, which have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant's bioactive constituents also contribute to its potential therapeutic uses, including wound healing, anti-cancer properties, and protection against oxidative stress.
